heading: Reconfigure Light with Phase Change Materials
introduction: Thin film deposition and characterization of Chalcogenide Phase Change Materials (PCMs), with a particular emphasis on switching studies using engineered optical and electrical pulses. Design and development of PCM-based metasurfaces for Reconfigurable, Non-Volatile Photonic Devices.
laserIntro: Upload a knife-edge scan with position in the first CSV column and transmitted power in the second. Compare the 1/e² beam diameter from a direct error-function fit with a Gaussian fit to the smoothed derivative. Choose the units used in your file.
